text_block_list.text:
The day after the tryouts, I'm about to
head home when I spot a
frantic—and
familiar—student.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're the trainer from yesterday,
right?!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
I haven't been able to find Ryan since
classes ended...
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
She's always training, so I figured I'd find
her on the course or in the
gym...
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
But she wasn't there! And after that weird
race yesterday, I'm starting
to get worried.
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: Got it. I'll help you look.

text_block_list.text: Really?! Thank you so much!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin and I take a quick moment to
decide where we should each
look, and
then we split up to search for Мэдзиро Райан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After checking the school grounds, I head
to the nearby river, parks,
shopping
district, and even the station. Just when all
hope seems
lost...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you doing here?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I tell Мэдзиро Райан about Ines Fujin's search
for her and how I offered
to help.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Gotcha... Aw, man, sorry about that. I'd
better apologize to Ines when
I get back.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I just really wanted to run outside today. I
was planning to be back
before anyone
started worrying, but I guess that was a
bust...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I stopped here to take a break, but then I
got caught up in the
scenery... Brings back
a lot of memories.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Yeah... You see, there's a steep hill close to the Mejiro family home. Like steep steЭпизод But if you make it to the top, you get an incredible view.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
When I was young, we used to play on that
hill all the time. We
Mejiro kids would race
up it to see who would be the first to see
that
breathtaking view.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: That includes McQueen too, of course.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: She's always been a fast one.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Out of our whole family, she's
probably the one I'm closest to.
I guess
we're like childhood friends... Or maybe
sisters?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
But... McQueen's always been the model
Mejiro, and I've been, well...
me. So even
though I'm technically older, I never really
could act like
a big sister to her.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: She's just... always been amazing.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: She knows what it means to be a Mejiro, and what sort of standard she's gotta set, both on and off the race course. And then she meets those standards.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Her manners are top-notch, and she
always looks so elegant. She's
everything
the fans of our family want...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: I really respect her.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: She's completely different from me.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Ahaha, thanks... You're a good person.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
But you don't need to lie. I know I could
never be like McQueen.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I don't run with the Mejiro name in mind,
and I don't think I ever will.
Even if I could,
I wouldn't be able to compete with her.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
After all, I just like running. Nothing
more... nothing less.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
No one would ever look at me and think of
me as a distinguished
daughter of a noble
lineage. Ahaha!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
She laughs it off, but I can tell that her
problems are eating her up
inside. If only I
could do something...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her dedication to working out has forged
her body into a
powerhouse. She's clearly
got more talent than she thinks.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In any case... it's clear that she's insecure
about her motivation, and
it's been
hindering her performance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As I try to puzzle out a solution to this
conundrum, I head back to
school.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wow, so you're doing the 3,200 meter
turf race, huh? What should I
do... Oh,
maybe the 5,000 meter freestyle race!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: There is no such race in the Tracen Meet!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I quickly remember that the Tracen Meet,
an event where students
can run in a
category of their choosing, will happen
soon.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Why do you always gotta do the long runs,
huh? Why not do the
1,200 meter and
make the competition eat your dust?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
My goal is to win the Tenno Sho, so I
obviously need to prepare for
that.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
The Tracen Meet attracts all sorts of fans,
so I must run in a way that
does not
besmirch the Mejiro name!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Мэдзиро МакКуин is aiming to
win the 3,200 meter turf
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан's problem seems deeply
linked to McQueen. Perhaps this
could be
a solution.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Huh? You think I should enter the same
race as McQueen?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list:
Obviously I can't force you, but think about it,
okay?

text_block_list.text: Well... It's not that I'm opposed...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
How long has it been since she and I ran
together anyway?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: And why'd you decide to tell me this now?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list:
I thought you might learn something from this
race.

text_block_list.text: Really?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
...All right. No promises, but I'll give it
some thought.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I decide to check on
Мэдзиро Райан. I don't see her at
the track or
in classes, so I decide to check the gym.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew... All done... Nah, let's do one more set.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Ah, it's you again!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Uh... I guess so, yeah.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Hey... I, uh... I did it. I signed up for the
same race as McQueen. The
3,200 meter
turf race.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I'll be honest, though... I don't really get
why I decided to do it.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I'm training more than usual, but I think I'm
just feeling a little antsy.
Not much more
to it.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
But... I'm still determined to do it. Feel
free to come check out the
race.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
With that, Мэдзиро Райан returns to her
workout, pumping out rep after
rЭпизод
text_block_list.name: Монолог
